svg.title: 06a · Identity, Access and RBAC: As-Is
svg.desc: Rows map six actors (FSP systems, hub operators, operations users, testers, switch services, platform engineers) to the surfaces they use, each with its authentication and authorisation status. A side panel lists identity hooks present in configuration but disabled. A bottom panel shows the business roles held inside the ledger, which are not access-control roles. Conclusion: no native RBAC in the deployed switch; authorisation is delegated to external infrastructure that is not present.
svg.text: Who can reach which surface, how they are authenticated and authorised today, and which identity hooks exist but are switched off

Each transfer links participants by role (e.g. PAYER_DFSP); settlement transfers use

The deployed switch has no native role-based access control on any API. Participant identity rests on headers, and operator actions are open. Real schemes delegate authentication and authorisation to external infrastructure (gateway, IdP, proxy, permission service) that this repository does not contain. The proposed operating model is in 06b.
Evidence: compose files, envs/*.env, TTK system_config.json, docker/reporting-hub-bop-api-svc/config/default.json, k8s-mojaloop-perf-tuning/, lab verification.
